format: VaultMate counting cases. The plugin owns this folder; `npm run sync-contract` copies it to the Android project.
fallbackDateMeaning: Creation date of a note, used for an idea with neither a created date nor a date in the note name.

statements: A paragraph line that carries the tag
Fresh thought written during an old brainstorm
Idea after a space and a full-width space
Plain idea in a CRLF note
Plain idea in a numbered list
Plan a surprise for a friend
Cuisiner un grand pot-au-feu le dimanche
Write the notes of the year
Plain seed with the seed sub-tag
Un jardin partagé pour le quartier
Decision scheduled today and due later
Decision with only a scheduled date
Prediction scheduled today without a review date

groupsMeaning.fresh/waiting/wilting: Open ideas of 0-2, 3-14, more than 14 days, from the created date, else a date in the note name, else fallbackDate. A future date is fresh. A plain tagged line has no created date: it goes by the note name or fallbackDate.
groupsMeaning.seeds: Open ideas tagged idea/<seedSubtag>; never in fresh, waiting or wilting.
groupsMeaning.overdue: Open decision or prediction whose review date (📅) is before today. A review goes by 📅 only: with just a ⏳ it is undated.
groupsMeaning.today: Open review whose 📅 is exactly today (also in week). A ⏳ today does not make a review due today.
groupsMeaning.week: Open review due from today to six days ahead. Only the plugin shows it.
groupsMeaning.upcoming: Open review due seven days or more ahead. Only the plugin shows it.
groupsMeaning.undated: Open review without a review date. Only the plugin shows it.
groupsMeaning.open: An idea or review is open unless its checkbox is x, X or - (done, cancelled): [ ], [/], [!], [<] and any other character are open. A tag inside inline code does not count.
groupsMeaning.plain tagged line: Any line that is not a heading and carries the idea tag (or a sub-tag) outside inline code is an open idea, task or not: a list item, a numbered item, a callout line, a paragraph, a line whose checkbox is not followed by an ASCII space or tab.
